review.notes: Fixing review by Claude Code session cc-cc0fde of the package written by cc-bab806. Fixed in place: (1) the tenfold condensation of the README was reversed for the 231 definition, construction, theorem and comparison targets, which now carry the plan's full statement, full hypothesis list, full API name list and every unit test with its one-line statement (previously statements were cut after about 70 characters, 64 of 97 hypothesis lists were truncated, and API/test lists showed 4/3 names); the 309 lemma targets stay one line each. The README grew from 194 KB to 556 KB, above the 200 KB packaging cap, which has no upstream counterpart (the largest TauCetiRoadmap README is 303 KB); every added byte is specification. (2) Planning residue removed: packet node ids and stage ids inside statements replaced by README numbers, `tauceti:`/`mathlib:`/`TC:` prefixes by plain Tau Ceti/Mathlib citations, `this node`/`packet sourceIssue` phrasing rewritten, the stray `### R3.5a` heading and the F0.2 header name fixed. (3) The six moved-down targets were checked against public sources: F0.64 locators corrected (EGA II 4.2.3, 3.5.3, 4.6.11; EGA III 2.3.1-2.3.2; Stacks 0B5U) and its graded-module clause restated; F0.65 dévissage restated to EGA III 3.1.2/3.1.3 (two-out-of-three, one test module per integral closed subscheme) with 5.6.2 added; R2.88 re-cited to Conrad's Jussieu paper (Thm 3.2.7, 3.3.1, 4.2.1(2)) with the Deligne-Rapoport numbers marked unverified; R3.73 gained KL15 Def. 2.3.2/Thm 2.3.4; R5.43 restated to Scholze-Weinstein Def. 2.4.1/Prop. 2.4.2 (qcqs transition maps, direct-limit affinoid criterion); F1.77 restated to de Jong Thm 6.5 (X integral, separated, flat, finite type; alteration into an open of a projective strictly semistable scheme). (4) Fifteen sampled locators in Huber 1994 (GDZ OCR), Wedhorn (arXiv) confirmed 15/15; four made more precise. (5) Duplication sweeps of all 133 definitions and constructions against Tau Ceti a91d3aaf, the current upstream roadmaps and Mathlib: no target to delete; eleven targets now state in one clause how they differ from existing declarations (`completionLocalization`, `SheafOfModules.ihom`, `fittingIdeal`, `IsRadiusLowerBound`, `affineBlowupι`, `IsTateRing.isModuleTopology`, `reesAlgebra.grade`, `IsLocallyFree`, `Scheme.Hom.finrank`, `IsCompactModule`, `MvPowerSeries.IsRestricted.subring`); R0.33 renamed to `AdicSpace.Hom.IsAdic` to avoid Tau Ceti's `PreAdicSpace.isAdic`. (6) Suggested.lean: the 95 declarations placed under `_root_.TauCeti.Huber.` for dot notation were moved into `TauCetiRoadmap.AdicSpacesPartII.Huber` and their 76 dot-notation uses rewritten to explicit application (as the AdicEtaleGeometry package did); 287 empty per-target section headers removed; the closing comment regenerated (334 README-only targets, the six moved-down ones included). lean-check exits 0 with 912 sorry warnings and no other diagnostic. intake check-files: 0 problems. Remaining limits, recorded in the report: Huber 1996 and Deligne-Rapoport locators are not verifiable (books not public); lemma statements live only in Suggested.lean and the packet.
